profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Senior Software Engineer | AI & Embedded Systems  
Driven by a passion for innovation, Valencia is a senior software engineer at the forefront of technology, specializing in AI, multi-model fine-tuning, GPU, LLM, QEMU, and machine learning.  
I have 8 years of experience in architecting, developing, and maintaining web and mobile applications in various industries. Hands-on experience in frontend technologies like React, React Native, Next.js, alongside backend proficiency in Python, Django, Flask and FastAPI and Java, .NET(C#). Expertise in building scalable systems using microservices and serverless architectures, with a solid focus on performance optimization.
Passionate about leveraging Agile methodologies, CI/CD pipelines, and DevOps to deliver high-quality solutions, with a commitment to continuous learning and innovation.

positions.title: Backend Engineer
positions.description:
API Development & Management
Building and maintaining APIs that facilitate interactions between the backend and front-end or mobile applications, providing a smooth interface with Koffee AI, our recommendation engine.

 Database Management
 designing and implement database structures (SQL and NoSQL) capable of handling extensive data, including user profiles, meal plans, and grocery lists. Ensuring data integrity, secure access, and efficient storage will be crucial in managing large datasets.

System Architecture & Scalability
Creating a scalable backend architecture that can grow with the platform's user base. By managing cloud infrastructure on AWS, Google Cloud, or Azure, you’ll ensure system stability and performance.
 Security & Performance Optimization
You’ll implement security protocols to protect sensitive information, such as user profiles and payment data, and apply performance tuning techniques to maintain system efficiency and load balancing as usage scales.

Collaboration with Frontend Team
Working closely with frontend engineers to integrate backend services with user-facing applications. Additionally, you will contribute to API documentation and specifications, aiding third-party service integration.

Testing & Debugging
Ensuring system reliability, write unit, integration, and performance tests. Quick issue resolution will also be essential to maintaining minimal downtime.

 Innovation & Iteration
As part of the product development cycle, I'll contribute ideas for platform improvements, staying updated on backend technologies to apply best practices in system architecture.

MVP Development
Working alongside the CTO and product managers, I'll help define technical requirements for the MVP, supporting features like personalized meal plans, grocery list generation, user account management, and third-party integrations for grocery store data.
